evidence: Original premium layout uses one accent, consistent radii, real product captures, visible focus states, and reduced-motion fallback.
Navigation remains a single desktop row below 80px; body copy stays within readable measure on mobile.
Open Graph, Twitter cards, canonical URLs, hreflang alternates, and max-image-preview directives pass automated checks.
Four language indexes link their own llms-full.txt corpus.
Question headings lead to self-contained answers; robots.txt permits major search and AI crawlers.
All quantitative claims trace to README product behavior; download safety defers to checksums.
Security headers constrain scripts, styles, images, framing, referrers, and browser permissions.
Every language page carries localized WebPage, SoftwareApplication, dateModified, and speakable structured data.
No Apple copy, logo, screenshot, source file, or protected trade dress is copied.
MIT license, repository, prerelease status, and checksum guidance are stated explicitly.
Cloudflare deployment artifacts remain isolated under website/ and vendor research is ignored.
WeChat paste-safe export passes its dedicated QA report.

conditions: npm build must be green before upload.
Deployment must use Cloudflare free hosting and verify https://readmd.syminu.online/ returns 200 for all language indexes.
A write-capable scoped Cloudflare token is required because the current token cannot create Pages or upload Worker assets.
